title: Syracuse, NY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Syracuse is a city in NY with a population of 148,000. Salt City with Syracuse University, the Carrier Dome, and the Erie Canal Museum. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.9.
